name: healthlog
description:
HealthLog is a self-hosted, privacy-first analysis engine for your Apple Health data. It ingests exports from the Health Auto Export iOS app over HTTP and computes correlations, anomalies, trends and seasonality entirely on your own hardware - no cloud, no telemetry, no external connections.

How it works: Health Auto Export (or any client) POSTs JSON to the ingest endpoint on port 8000, authenticated with the INGEST_SECRET you set (sent as the X-Ingest-Token header). Samples are deduplicated and stored idempotently in a TimescaleDB/PostgreSQL database. A nightly job (ANALYSIS_CRON, default 03:30) runs the statistical pipeline with FDR-controlled correlations; results and optional LLM-generated narration reports are written under /config. Check the service with GET /api/health.

**Database (required):** HealthLog needs an external TimescaleDB/PostgreSQL 16 database (recommended image timescale/timescaledb:2.17.2-pg16). Create a database and user, then set DATABASE_URL to the psycopg v3 connection string, e.g. postgresql+psycopg://healthlog:PASSWORD@HOST:5432/healthlog.

**Storage:** Map /config to persist the optional config.yaml, the import/ backfill directory, narration/ reports and logs. Use PUID/PGID to control file ownership (Unraid: 99/100).

**Optional config file:** Drop a config.yaml into /config to tune the analysis pipeline, your personal profile (birth year, sex, HR zones), workout load metrics, Ollama narration and push notifications. Changes are picked up automatically without a restart. A Grafana dashboard is included in the project.

paths.name: config
paths.description: Persistent app directory. Holds the optional config.yaml, the import/ backfill directory, narration/ reports and log files.

ports.name: WebGUI
ports.description: HTTP ingest endpoint and health check (POST your Apple Health export here; GET /api/health for status)

variables.name: DATABASE_URL
variables.description: Required: psycopg v3 connection string to your external TimescaleDB/PostgreSQL 16 database. Replace PASSWORD and HOST with your database user's password and the database host/IP.

variables.name: INGEST_SECRET
variables.description: Required: shared secret that Health Auto Export sends in the X-Ingest-Token header. Use any strong random string and configure the same value in the iOS app.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: Host user ID that owns the files under /config (Unraid: 99)

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Host group ID for the files under /config (Unraid: 100)

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Container timezone. Also sets the daily grid used for analysis bucketing and the schedule for ANALYSIS_CRON.

variables.name: ANALYSIS_CRON
variables.description: When the nightly analysis runs (5-field cron expression, evaluated in TZ). Default is 03:30.

variables.name: LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: Log verbosity: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING or ERROR.

variables.name: LOG_FORMAT
variables.description: Log output format: text or json.

variables.name: CONFIG_FILE
variables.description: Path to the optional structured configuration file inside the container.
